title: S149 later notes: Questions footer, hint polish, pane scroll keys

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Later notes from the S149 relay (run-20261026-162203-0595, landed fff74f2), not fixed in that slice.
Owner decisions (2026-10-26, session a2bf7e0e): drop the Questions list's body footer "[enter] open" (`internal/tui/questions.go:146`, docs/dashboard.md:782) to match Decisions; on Waves with nothing ticked the hint keeps not showing l (accepted).
Other notes:
- Lineup budget rows lost the "type a whole number" hint; add it for row 2 and up.
- Should "q quit" never drop on the main views, as "? help" no longer does?
- Remove "?help" from the sidebar header now that the hint shows it.
- Style the Questions tab count; give the read-only note on the ledger pane its own style.
- Wire ctrl+d/u and their hints to the decision, roadmap-item and waves-item panes; S151 should reuse pane.room.
- Add a help note that ctrl+u clears a field.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: TestQuestionsBodyHasNoEnterOpenFooter; TestWavesBudgetRowsShowTheWholeNumberHint (row 2 and up only); TestQuitHintNeverDropsOnMainViews (80 and 100 columns, every main view); TestSidebarHeaderHasNoHelpCue; TestQuestionsTabCountIsStyled; TestLedgerPaneReadOnlyNoteHasItsOwnStyle; TestCtrlDUScrollDecisionRoadmapAndWavesItemPanes (pane.room half page); TestCtrlDUHintsShowInThosePanes; TestHelpMentionsCtrlUClearsAField; goldens.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Owner decisions are in the slice notes (2026-10-26 and 2026-10-29). Tests first; re-anchor line numbers from the code. 1. Drop the Questions body footer '[enter] open' (internal/tui/questions.go ~146) and its sentence in docs/dashboard.md ~782. 2. Waves lineup budget rows 2 and up show 'type a whole number' again (internal/tui/waves.go). 3. 'q quit' gets the highest dropLine on the main views, like '? help' (internal/tui/keys.go); other hints drop first. 4. Remove '?help' from the sidebar header (internal/tui/view.go). 5. Style the Questions tab count like the other tab counts and give the ledger pane's read-only note its own Dim style (judgement: the UI pass checks it). 6. Wire ctrl+d / ctrl+u (half page, reuse pane.room from S151) into the decision, roadmap-item and waves-item panes (internal/tui/pane.go, waves.go, roadmap pane), with hints in those panes. 7. Add one help line: ctrl+u clears a field (watch the 100x30 help headroom; merge lines as S164 did if needed). Out of scope: anything else in the S149 later notes. UI slice: UI pass (r14).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- go test -race -count=1 ./...
- go vet ./...
- gofmt -l .
- go test ./internal/tui -update, then review the golden diff
- slicer check
